subject: Request: Expand 60m intro demo into 3-day engineering lab (reschedule & logistics)
body:
--- Message 1 (original request) ---
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to expand intro demo into a 3-day engineering lab

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro demo yesterday — Renee and I came away wanting a deeper, hands-on engagement so our platform team can evaluate integration and performance at scale.

Instead of the 60-minute intro, would Redwood be open to running a 3-day engineering lab (two days of hands-on integration + day three for on-site tuning and validation)? Our execs prefer the week of Oct 20 but travel budgets are tight.

Proposed windows: Oct 20–22 or Oct 25–27.
Questions for you:
- Do you have engineers available for a multi-day lab?
- Can you support hybrid (first two days remote, last day on-site) if travel limited?
- Any rough estimate on pricing / SOW footprint so I can flag procurement?

I've attached a quick SOW draft (Helio_SOW_v0.3.pdf) and a one-page list of goals. If we can confirm scope and timing this week, procurement can accelerate.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
HelioHealth

--- Message 2 (Marissa replies, loops internal) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to expand intro demo into a 3-day engineering lab

Hi Samir — great to hear the demo sparked interest. Short answers: yes (we can run a multi-day lab), and yes to hybrid in most cases.

I've sketched a draft 3-day agenda (attached: Draft_Agenda_3-DayLab.md) and copied Aditya and Priyom to confirm engineering availability and SOW/budget constraints. Quick asks so we scope correctly:
- Key success criteria (e.g., max latency at X throughput, integration points, data volumes)
- Expected Helio headcount for the lab and roles (infra, ML eng, product)
- Any systems that need pre-configured network/VPN access or dummy data

If Oct 20–22 is preferred by you, flag it now; Aditya will confirm internal availability. Otherwise we can propose alternative windows.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps finalize details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--- Message 3 (internal availability & constraint) ---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to expand intro demo into a 3-day engineering lab

Marissa / Samir — heads up on internal constraints: our core infra/serving team has a planned maintenance week Oct 18–22 that reduces available engineer headcount. We can staff a lab, but the earliest fully staffed option is Oct 25–27.

We can still do a lighter, remote-first lab on Oct 20–22 if Helio is OK with a smaller team focused on architecture/hand-off rather than deep load tuning.

Also: for multi-day engagements we formalize via an SOW (Ad-hoc lab vs. Dedicated PoC). I reviewed Helio_SOW_v0.3.pdf and added cost notes — I'll circulate a redline. Pricing ballpark (remote-first 3 days): $18k–$24k depending on seniority and deliverables; on-site day adds travel + per-diem.

If Samir confirms Oct 25–27 that's likely simplest for our staffing.

— Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 (external agrees to alternate dates, requests hybrid) ---
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliohealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Renee Cho <renee.cho@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to expand intro demo into a 3-day engineering lab

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clarity. Oct 25–27 works better for Helio.

Given our execs' travel plans, can we do:
- Oct 25–26: virtual (deep integration + runbook + automated tests)
- Oct 27: optional on-site for final tuning and exec walkthrough (if budget allows)

Please confirm if this hybrid plan is feasible and what on-site travel estimate looks like. Also, is there a short prep checklist we should complete before day 1?

Samir

--- Message 5 (Marissa loops product/solutions engineer, attaches links) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to expand intro demo into a 3-day engineering lab

Samir — that plan works. Looping in Priya (Solutions Engineering) to own the agenda and prep checklist.

Next steps I propose:
1) We hold one 30-min discovery call this week to finalize success criteria and headcount. Please send three times that work for you.
2) We publish a prep doc and tech checklist (VPN, service accounts, sample data scope) — Priya will share this.
3) We will redline the SOW and share an updated DocuSign link.

Provisional agenda and SOW are here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/agenda-helio-lab (Draft_Agenda_3-DayLab.md, Helio_SOW_v0.3.pdf).

Can you confirm: Helio attendees + whether the on-site day will be approved if the travel estimate looks reasonable?

Thanks — cc'ing Aditya and Priyom so they see the logistics.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--- Message 6 (Priya supplies checklist and asks for prep doc) ---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to expand intro demo into a 3-day engineering lab

Hi Samir — happy to run point on this. Short checklist and notes below. I've attached a one-page prep checklist and a draft agenda in the Drive link Marissa shared.

Tech/Logistics checklist (please confirm items before day 1):
- VPN/whitelist: IP ranges to be shared by Helio security (we need at least 48 hours to provision)
- Service accounts: AWS role with STS or a test S3 bucket + sample dataset (anonymized)
- API keys: Test and prod keys separated; please provide a token for test env only
- Headcount: list of engineers + approx. tasks for each day (integration, load runs, validation)
- Exec attendance: name(s) for Oct 27 on-site walkthrough (so we can prepare slides and exec summary)

Regarding hybrid cadence: we recommend remote-first for the integration days, with the on-site day reserved for network/firewall troubleshooting and performance tuning if needed. If Helio confirms travel, we estimate travel + per-diem of ~$2.5k per Redwood engineer for the on-site day (travel policy attached as stub).

When you confirm headcount and preferred calendar window (Oct 25–27 confirmed by Aditya), I'll publish the prep doc and send calendar invites. Also, please complete this 5-question prep form: https://forms.example/helio-prep (helps us size infra for load tests).

Thanks — Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

(Attachments referenced: Helio_SOW_v0.3.pdf, Draft_Agenda_3-DayLab.md, Prep_Checklist_1p.pdf)
